program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((src (find-color g 2))
         (arr (find-color g 1)))
    (define (slash dr dc) (list (- 0 dc) (- 0 dr)))
    (define (backslash dr dc) (list dc dr))
    (if (and (= (length src) 1) (= (length arr) 1))
        (let* ((s (first src))
               (a (first arr))
               (dr (- (first a) (first s)))
               (dc (- (second a) (second s))))
          (if (not (= (+ (abs dr) (abs dc)) 1))
              g
              (let loop ([out g] [r (+ (first a) dr)] [c (+ (second a) dc)] [dr dr] [dc dc] [fuel 500])
                (if (or (= fuel 0) (not (in-bounds? r c (rows g) (cols g))) (= (at g r c) 5))
                    out
                    (let* ((v (at g r c))
                           (nd (cond [(= v 3) (slash dr dc)]
                                     [(= v 4) (backslash dr dc)]
                                     [else (list dr dc)]))
                           (next-out (if (= v 0) (set-cell out r c 8) out)))
                      (loop next-out (+ r (first nd)) (+ c (second nd)) (first nd) (second nd) (- fuel 1)))))))
        g)))
